description: Issue #839: at RUN TIME a profile keyword is a built-in name unconditionally. `execute()` has no active profile set — it runs every profile's primitives and the reader recognises all six block heads regardless of profile — so the declaration-slot guard cannot be gated on one, and `spec/grammar.md:410` says it must not be: "a name that could be declared in one implementation but not in another would be invisible and unpredictable to a learner". So `define ask` halts at phase-1 registration with `ol-reserved-word` and the `ask` call on line 4 never runs. A corpus that checks a rule at one stage does not cover it at the other — keep an executing case for any rule both stages implement. `check()` and `execute()` reach that answer through one predicate, `@openlogo/parser`'s `isBuiltInName`, rather than composing it each; `packages/parser/src/built-in-names.test.mjs` and the Core-only fixture `core-language/check/reserved-word-profile-names-under-core-alone` pin the two sides against it.

diagnostics.message: ask is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
